admin.title: Administration
admin.user_error: Enter a unique username and a password of at least 8 characters.
admin.mail_help: Used by everyone who has no personal e-mail settings.
admin.smtp_password_help: Leave empty to keep the current one.
admin.auto_approve: Add automatically on a confident match
admin.auto_approve_help: If the online match is at least 85% and there is no duplicate, the book is added without review.
admin.lang_intro: Every label in the interface is translatable. English is the reference: translations are made from it, and missing texts fall back to English.
admin.lang_ref_help: You can change the reference texts but not remove them.
admin.guest_browse_help: Visitors can look through the library, search and open book pages without an account. Downloading, sending, reading status and every change still need a sign-in.
admin.default_lang_help: The interface language for visitors and new users, and the language of category tags. Everyone can still choose their own language.
admin.online_lookup_help: Search the online sources below when books are uploaded and on the book page.
admin.watch_folder_help: Ebooks copied into this folder are imported automatically. Turn it off to pause, for example while you reorganise the folder.
admin.watch_folder_off: No watched folder was set at installation (INGEST_DIR / a mounted folder), so there is nothing to switch here.
admin.sources_help: Enabled sources in order of importance. Shelfy searches all of them at once and ranks the results by how well they match; when two matches are about equally good, the source higher in the list wins.
admin.google_key_help: Without a key Google shares a small common quota, which is often used up – then Google Books returns nothing. A free key from the Google Cloud console fixes this.
admin.src_moly: Hungarian book database with descriptions, series and tags – the best source for Hungarian books.
admin.src_google: Worldwide, many languages; descriptions and covers.
admin.src_openlibrary: Free worldwide catalogue; good for older and English-language books.
admin.src_dnb: German National Library – books published in German-speaking countries.
admin.src_bnf: French National Library – books published in France.
admin.src_bn_pl: Polish National Library – books published in Poland.
admin.src_ndl: National Diet Library of Japan – Japanese books.

mail.title: Personal e-mail sending
mail.help: If you fill this in, books are sent to your Kindle from your own e-mail account. If left empty, the shared account set by the administrator is used.
mail.src_own: Your own settings are in use
mail.src_global: The shared e-mail account is in use
mail.from_help: Add this address to the approved senders in your Amazon account.

lookup.title: Refresh metadata online
lookup.intro: Search the online sources (Moly.hu, Google Books, Open Library) with fresh data. Pick the right match and tick the fields to take over.
lookup.none: No results – try a different title, author or ISBN.
lookup.start: Start a search on the left.

mailhelp.title: Help: setting up Gmail and Kindle approval
mailhelp.gmail_1: Turn on 2-Step Verification in your Google Account (Security) – app passwords cannot be created without it.
mailhelp.gmail_2: Create an app password, e.g. named “Shelfy”:
mailhelp.gmail_3: Enter the 16-character code in the Password field (spaces do not matter). This is not your Google password.
mailhelp.gmail_4: Save, then send a test e-mail.
mailhelp.gmail_note: If you cannot see app passwords: 2-Step Verification is off, or it is a work account where the administrator has disabled them.
mailhelp.amazon_text: Add the sender address to your approved senders: Manage Your Content and Devices → Preferences → Personal Document Settings → Approved Personal Document E-mail List. Your Kindle e-mail address (…@kindle.com) is shown there too.

log.password_reset: Password reset from the command line: {name}

backup.intro: Shelfy has two parts: the database (book metadata, users, shelves, activity log, settings – small) and the library folder (book files and covers – the big part). A full backup puts both into one ZIP file.
backup.db_only_help: About {size}. Enough if the library folder is backed up some other way (e.g. by the NAS) or stays where it is.
backup.full_help: Database + all book files and covers, about {size}. Moves the whole of Shelfy in one go.
backup.secret_note: The backup contains password hashes and the encryption key (for the encrypted SMTP passwords): keep it somewhere safe.
backup.restore_help: Restores the database from an earlier backup, and the book files too for a full backup. A safety backup of the current database is made first. Restore large (multi-GB) backups from the command line instead.
backup.restore_library: Also restore the book files (if the backup contains them)
backup.restore_confirm: I understand the current data will be replaced by the backup
backup.restore_confirm_js: Restore this backup? It replaces the current data (a safety backup is made first).
backup.restored: Restored: {books} books, {files} book files extracted. Backup of the previous state: {safety}.
backup.restored_missing: {n} book file(s) are missing from the library folder.
backup.check_help: Checks that every book file listed in the database exists in the library folder. Useful after moving, or after restoring the database only.
backup.auto_on: Daily database backup on the server
backup.keep: Number of daily backups to keep
backup.cli_help: For a large library, full backups and restores are easier from the command line (details in Help).

about.lead: A self-hosted ebook library for the family: upload with inspection and online metadata, a searchable catalogue, conversion, Send to Kindle and a Kindle view.

install.title: Install Shelfy as an app
install.text: Opens full screen with its own icon on the home screen – handy for reading, too.
install.ios_1: In the browser, tap the Share button
install.ios_3: Then tap “Add” – Shelfy appears among your apps
install.android_2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”
